title: Potion of Glorious Vaulting
summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to triple your jump distance for 10 turns.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Jump distance is tripled for 10 turns.
fields.Throw: The shared potions table lists the jump effect as throwable. The checked sources leave its splash radius and affected targets unspecified.
fields.Crafting: Combine Sublimate of Wispweed with any Ashes.
fields.Creative use: Cross a gap or reach high ground while the effect lasts.
fields.Base value: 13 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added source-reviewed native BG3 gameplay, consumption, and crafting details.
